name: Zarbag's Gitz
inspire: Each time you gain a sixth or subsequent Glory point, Inspire a friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Squig Herder
reactions.rulesText: After you deploy a friendly Drizgit, you must immediately place each friendly Squig ({icon:squig}) in an empty hex adjacent to them that is not a starting hex and that does not contain a feature token.

reactions.name: Spinnin'
reactions.rulesText:
Snirk cannot be given Guard tokens.
Each time a fighter is placed in, is pushed into or enters a hex adjacent to a friendly Snirk, inflict 1 damage on that fighter.

reactions.name: Volley
reactions.rulesText:
If a friendly fighter's weapon has the {icon:volley} runemark, you have access to the following Weapon ability:

Volley ({icon:volley}): Immediately after the Attack, if it was successful, you can pick another friendly fighter whose weapon has Volley ({icon:volley}). That fighter Attacks with that weapon. You can only use this ability once per turn.

abilities.name: Slippery Gitz
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you pick a friendly fighter to Move.
abilities.flavorText: Grots are hard to pin down at the best of times - and Zarbag's Gitz especially so.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly Grot ({icon:grot}) with no Move or Charge tokens adjacent to them. After the first fighter Moves, that friendly Grot ({icon:grot}) can Move. You can only use this ability once per turn.

abilities.name: Fungal Burst
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Grot ({icon:grot}) is slain by an attacker adjacent to them.
abilities.flavorText: Grots often carry bunches of mushrooms that, when struck, release clouds of poisonous spores.
abilities.rulesText: Give the attacker a Stagger token. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Gang Up
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Zarbag's Gitz have heard about fighting fair. They just choose not to.
abilities.rulesText: In the next turn, friendly fighters' melee weapons have +1 Attack dice for each other friendly Grot ({icon:grot}) adjacent to the target. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Make Some Noise!
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: There are few better ways to rile up a squig than making a racket.
abilities.rulesText: Push each friendly Squig ({icon:squig}) up to 2 hexes. For the rest of the battle round, those Squigs ({icon:squig}) cannot hold treasure tokens or Delve. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: A nine-strong grot horde, the densest swarm in the game, built around fragile, low-health bodies that overwhelm through sheer numbers. It wins by ganging up, stacking extra Attack dice for every friendly grot crowding a target and chaining moves through the swarm. Squigs and the spinning fanatic add board hazards, but each model dies easily.
